This listing covers BQ048 / A212, source model A212. Select the photographed product and color-size options offered on this page; other models are not included.

What quantity prices are currently listed?

Current displayed unit prices for BQ048 / A212: USD 9.49 from 2 pairs, USD 9.19 from 50 pairs, USD 9.09 from 100 pairs. Confirm the final quotation for the selected quantities and specifications; unquoted freight and taxes are excluded.
How should I request colors, sizes and fit information?

For A212, choose from the current color-size options on this page and state the quantity for each option. Request measurements for the selected size before ordering; international size conversion and fit are confirmed for the actual product.

Send the destination, postal code, quantities and requested dispatch date for A212. Availability, production or dispatch timing and freight are confirmed in the order quotation; this answer does not promise ready stock.
Can I ask for a sample before a bulk order?
Ask about sample availability and charges for BQ048 / A212. Review the actual sample, measurements and fit before agreeing a bulk order.

For A212, refer to the current product attributes and send the exact component composition, material grade or test standard required for your order. Any unspecified material detail and test evidence need confirmation; no additional tested performance or certification is promised.
